job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: November30,2022 at 4:30pm HST; issue date and RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: This is a Rice University RFP for retirement-plan audit services, not the Hawaii ERS 2022 RFP for real assets investment consultant services. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Rice University (“the University”) requests a proposal to provide external audit services for the William Marsh Rice University Defined Contribution and Supplemental 403(b) Retirement Plans
Proposals must be submitted electronically, by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, January 14, 2022
